div.div: 3 ناصبه الشَّرَّ , (inf. n. مُنَاصَبَةٌ, TA,) (tropical:) He made an open show of evil conduct, mischief, or malevolence, to him; (K;) and in like manner, of enmity, (TA,) and of war; (S, TA;) as also ↓ نَصَبَهُ , (K,) unaugmented. (TA: in the CK, ↓ نصّبه .) See also نَصَبَ لَهُ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
